title: Correction of where inventory valuation Power BI reports are shown
summary: Inventory valuation Power BI reports now appear only in the Business Manager Role Center with their own dedicated section, instead of being shown in the Finance Manager Role Center.
key_points: Inventory valuation Power BI reports moved from Finance Manager RC to Business Manager RC
Reports now have their own dedicated section in Business Manager RC
Finance Manager RC no longer displays these reports
Improves report organization and role-specific relevance
quote: Instead now they only show in the Business Manager RC with their own section.
